mainText: Hello, Verona! At 1 PM, here is today's balanced dish. We are seeing 52 degrees under mainly clear skies at Harriet Park. If you are heading out tonight, look to the west-northwest over Cross Plains around 6:34 PM to catch the International Space Station as it tracks toward Madison near Home Depot, appearing low near the horizon.

The City of Verona has released its latest financial documentation, including the 2027 adopted budget. Residents can reach out to the finance department at City Hall for more information on the city's financial outlook.

Today you can head to Insight Wellness for yoga. Tomorrow, the town is bustling with trivia at Hop Haus, Lake Lou-ee, and Paddy Mac's, plus live music at Paddy Mac's and pizza and a pitcher specials at Lake Lou-ee.
On October 25, Verona police officers were dispatched to Plympton Street and Rita Avenue where they located a driver passed out at the intersection, resulting in an arrest for O W I.
Today's flavor is the decadent Chocolate Volcano. The store is currently open and will be serving up scoops until 10 PM tonight.
